items.title: Battery localisation is no longer optional for Indian EV makers
items.summary: India's electric vehicle sector is rapidly expanding, prompting a renewed emphasis on local battery production. The government is taking steps to fortify the domestic supply chain. However, there are hurdles to increasing production capacities. Initiatives are being launched to boost technological access and cultivate a skilled workforce.
